chapter: Trent's band: Texas, St. Louis and the road east
title: John Fielding as singer and the band's dress
summary: Fielding sang sweetly and was beautifully dressed; the band was the best dressed in the business.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: So you go to Cleveland, the Plantation, (inaudible) must have gotten the job, I guess, at the Plantation. Wasn't John Fielding doing something, was he travelling with you too?
John was still with the band.
What kind of style did he have as a singer?
He had a sweet style and he could--but he was mostly--everybody worshipped him. He was suave, he was beautifully dressed, he was dignity; he dressed like mad.
All you guys--that was one of the features of your band. You had to be just about the best dressed band in the business.
A beautifully dressed band. Look on every picture they've made.
